LanguageData.CC_Herd_Leader: The colony's herd goes where {PET_nameDef} goes. The old {KIND} has led them to water and back for a while without anyone saying so; today {PAWN_nameDef} said so, and gave {PET_objective} the name.\n\nThe herd will follow {PET_nameDef} until {PET_pronoun} is too old to lead it, and then one of {PET_possessive} own, if there is one.
LanguageData.CC_Herd_NewLeader_Line: The herd follows {PET_nameDef} now, of {LINE}'s own blood: the {COUNT} generation to lead it. {PAWN_nameDef} says the herd settled on it before anyone did.
LanguageData.CC_Herd_NewLeader_New: The herd follows {PET_nameDef} now, a {KIND} of no line the colony knows. A new line begins with {PET_objective}.
LanguageData.CC_Herd_Generation: {PET_nameDef}, born today to {OTHER_nameDef}, is the {COUNT} generation of {LINE}'s line in the colony's herd.
LanguageData.CC_Herd_GenerationChronicle: The {COUNT} generation of {LINE}'s line was born to the herd: {PET_nameDef}.
LanguageData.CC_Herd_SpringCalf: {PET_nameDef}, born this morning to {OTHER_nameDef}, is the first of the year born to the colony's herd. {PAWN_nameDef} is going down to the pens to look, and will stay until it stands.
LanguageData.CC_Herd_SpringCalfChronicle: The first calf of spring, {PET_nameDef}, was born to the herd.
LanguageData.CC_Herd_LastSeason: {PET_nameDef}, who leads the colony's herd, is old now: gray at the muzzle, slow to rise, the herd walking at {PET_possessive} pace. {PAWN_nameDef} thinks this is the old leader's last season, and means to make it a good one.\n\nWhen {PET_nameDef} goes, the herd will follow one of {PET_possessive} own, if there is one.
LanguageData.CC_Herd_LastSeasonChronicle: {PET_nameDef}, the herd's leader, began {PET_possessive} last season.
LanguageData.CC_Herd_Gone: {PET_nameDef}, who led the colony's herd, is dead. The herd stood about the pens this morning not knowing where to go. In a day or two one of them will take the lead, one of {PET_possessive} own blood if there is one, and {PAWN_nameDef} will give it the name.
LanguageData.CC_Herd_LeaderChronicle: {PET_nameDef} became the leader of the colony's herd.
LanguageData.CC_Beast_Named: A wild {KIND} has been on the colony's land for days now, keeping its distance and keeping to its ways, and {PAWN_nameDef} has started calling it {PET_nameDef}. The name has stuck.\n\nIt has taken nothing of the colony's yet. In a few days the council will be asked what to make of it; until then the colony watches it from the wall.
LanguageData.CC_Beast_NamedChronicle: {PAWN_nameDef} named the wild {KIND} on the colony's land {PET_nameDef}.
LanguageData.CC_Beast_End_stays: {PET_nameDef} has been on the colony's land a whole season, and nobody speaks of hunting it any more. It is part of the land now.
LanguageData.CC_Beast_End_gone: {PET_nameDef} has moved on. The far meadow is empty in the mornings, and the colony finds it misses the sight.
LanguageData.CC_Beast_End_hunted: The hunters brought {PET_nameDef} down. {PAWN_nameDef}, who named it, was not among them.
LanguageData.CC_Beast_End_died: {PET_nameDef} is dead, out on the land where it lived. The colony found it in the morning.
LanguageData.CC_Beast_End_tamed: {PET_nameDef} answers to the colony now. The handlers' patience, and {PAWN_nameDef}'s, won out.
LanguageData.CC_Beast_End_driven: {PET_nameDef} was driven off the colony's land with torches and noise, and has not come back.
LanguageData.CC_Overview_HerdLeaderLine: {PET_nameDef} leads the herd, the {ORD} generation of {LINE}'s line ({COUNT} head).
LanguageData.CC_Overview_BeastWatched: {PET_nameDef}, the {KIND} the colony watches: {STANCE}, named {DAYS} ago.
LanguageData.CC_Overview_Rumour: A shiny {SPECIES} is rumoured about, for {DAYS} more.
LanguageData.CC_Beast_Stance_fed: fed at the edge of the trees
